claim: A requirement for zero failures under load conflicts with a requirement to leave real-stall tests failing while Hub fixes are out of scope, so either tests with an open filed finding are excluded or the fixes are brought into scope.

citations.quote: A requirement for zero failures under load cannot sit beside a requirement to leave real-stall tests failing while Hub fixes are out of scope.
Either exclude tests that have an open filed finding, or bring the fixes into scope.
